content.text: {"relation":"REFINED","consensus_summary":"The Gospel is the good news of God’s saving reign through Jesus Christ, centrally expressed in his death and resurrection and calling for faith and repentance.","book_summary":"The Gospel is specifically the gospel of the kingdom, identified with covenant renewal and God’s law or word proceeding from Zion.","consensus_core_identification":"Good news of salvation and God’s reign accomplished through Jesus Christ, especially his death and resurrection.","book_core_identification":"Good news of God’s kingdom understood as the renewed covenant and the promulgation and internalization of divine law from Zion.","core_relation":"BOOK_NARROWS","extension_relation":"PARTIAL_RECLASSIFICATION","boundary_disagreement":"The consensus includes kingdom proclamation, covenant renewal, forgiveness, and Christ’s death and resurrection within the Gospel, with the Christ-event as its defining center.
